searchText: Why 2? I get included very reliably with 1. What I do find interesting is that some type 2 transactions sets priority fee crazily high. Not sure if this is a wallet issue or the user not understanding how it works. https://etherscan.io/tx/0x8509522f6313950e7ebbb4d91548bc4c174bba854ec3f33630b94a6f923793bd https://etherscan.io/tx/0x1a6c8f370de62d7b4e0cf33f50b5ea7b1e1a4175cd11bb97406d5a9761c41820 some examples This one is part two of a flashbots sandwich, the high priority fee is an MEV bribe to the miner. thanks! That's interesting I think sometimes MetaMask also defaults to what the application recommends and in some cases the PF is equal to the Max Fee. I’ve found 2 to be a bit quicker (~3 blocks) than 1 (5-10 blocks) But 1 def does work
